tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (327)༄༅/ /bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi zab khrid kyi rim pa snying por dril ba grub gnyis mchog sbyin ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /
(327)༄༅/ /bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi zab khrid kyi rim pa snying por dril ba grub gnyis mchog sbyin ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (327)༄༅// bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi zab khrid kyi rim pa snying por dril ba grub gnyis mchog sbyin ces bya ba bzhugs so//

(328)༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ dkon mchog gsum dngos thugs rje'i zla ris ni// yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar bcas// shar ba'i mod la phan bde'i chu gter che// rab tu rgyas mdzad dpal ldan bla mar 'dud// gang gi bka' drin bab pa yis// reg pas bsil ba'i gaṅgā ni// bdag blo'i lam gsum la chags pas// zab don ngal 'tsho cir yang rgyas// de slad 'di na 'phags bod kyi// mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i gtsug gi nor// mnyam med jo bo yab sras kyi// gdams pa'i snying po cung zad dbye// de la 'dir lnga brgya pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu mnyam med jo bo chen pos za ma tog bkod pa la sogs pa'i mdo'i sbas don mthar thug pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs dang mthun par bkral ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' gdams pa rnams kyi gsang chos man ngag thun mong ma yin pa zab pa las kyang ches zab ba'i snyan brgyud thig le bcu drug gi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len pa'i tshul la gnyis/ da ltar gyi phyag gzhes ltar zab 'khrid kyi snying po mdor bsdus te bstan pa dang*// de las rgyas par (329)spros pa'i sgo phyogs tsam mtshon pa'o// dang po la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni nor bu'i phreng ba le'u gnyis par/ sras kyi thu bo spyan ras gzigs// khyod kyi rjes 'brangs kho mos bskyang*// kho mos gdams pa 'di longs la// rjes su 'brangs la bstan par gyis// skyabs gnas bla ma dran par mdzod// lus ni lha yi rang bzhin te// ngag ni bzlas brjod rgyun par mdzod// 'gro ba ma lus pha mar soms// sems kyi gnas lugs stong par dpyod// lnga po 'di yi skya bar nas// dge rtsa thams cad dag par mdzod// ces gsungs pa ltar rjes dran lnga'i sgo nas nyams su len pa la/ thog mar sbyor ba'i chos gnas khang byi dor bya zhing sku gsung thugs kyi rten dgram/

mchod pa g.yo med pa btsal la bkod pas mdzes par bshams/ stan bde ba la lus gnad bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas skyabs sems dang*/ tshogs zhing gsal gdab la/ yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab pa rnams (330)tshul bzhin du byas nas/ de nas lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi sgo nas skyabs gnas bla ma rjes su dran pa dang*/ skyes bu chung 'bring gnyis sngon du 'gro bas skyes bu chen po'i nyams len gyis 'gro drug pha mar rjes su dran pa dang*/ khyad par phar phyin tha ma zhi lhag gnyis la bslabs pas sems kyi gnas lugs stong par rjes su dran pa rnams byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i gdams ngag las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin nyams su blangs pas rgyud sbyong ba ni spyi'i sngon 'gro'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la'ang rjes dran lnga las/ dang po skyabs gnas bla ma rjes su dran pa ni// rang nyid tha mal du gnas pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar dran pa tsam gyis dgos 'dod thams cad yid bzhin du stsol bar nus pa'i dpag bsam gyi ljon shing sdong po yal ga lo 'dab bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i rnam par bzhugs pa nas bzung*/ nor bu'i phreng ba'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa gtso bor gyur pa'i bla ma dang*/ mtha' bskor du skyabs gnas dkon mchog rgya mtsho til gyi gang bu kha bye ba'am/ nyi zer la rdul 'khrigs pa bzhin mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar rang gzhan sems can thams cad sa chen po'i dreg pa bzhin du 'khod pas/ dang 'dod yid ches kyi dad pa shugs drag pos kun nas bslangs te/ thun gyi mgor dge sbyor gang byed bye bar 'gyur ba'i sngags bzla bar gsungs pas/ oṃ saṃ bhā ra saṃ bhā ra bi ma na sa ra ma hā dzambha ba hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci nus dang de nas// 'dren pa mnyam med ston pa bcom ldan 'das// gangs ri'i mgon po rje btsun spyan ras gzigs// rgyal yum sgrol ma bcom ldan mi g.yo mgon// bka' gdams lha mchog bzhi la gsol ba 'debs// byams pa thogs med dbyig gnyen rnam (331)grol sde// mchog sde dul ba'i sde dang grags pa'i sde// seng bzang ku sā li gnyis gser gling pa// rgya chen spyod pa'i brgyud par gsol ba 'debs// 'jam dbyangs yod med phyogs 'jig klu sgrub dang*// zla ba grags pa rig pa'i khu byug che// sangs rgyas dgongs skyong 'phags pa yab sras te// zab mo lta ba'i brgyud par gsol ba 'debs// thugs rje chen po bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang*// mchog gzigs tai lo pa dang nā ro pa// dpal mchog ḍombi pa dang a ti sha

/nyams len byin rlabs brgyud par gsol ba 'debs// lam bzang gsal mdzad mgon po a ti sha /bka' gdams bstan pa'i mes po rgyal ba 'brom// legs pa'i shes rab rgyal mtshan bzhi la sogs// dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// srid la zhen log rkyen ngan grogs su shar// bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i rlabs chen spyod la zhugs// srid rtsa drung 'byin lta bas rgyas btab ste// thun mong lam bzang bgrod par byin gyis rlobs// gsang sngags sgor zhugs dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung*// zab gsal gnyis med lha yi rnal 'byor gyis// zung 'jug snying gi thig le mngon gyur nas// 'gro kun mgon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mdor bsdus pa sngon du 'gro bas/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang bcas pa la 'jigs shing skrags pas snying thag pa nas skyabs su 'gro ba'i 'dun pa dang bcas/ bdag dang 'gro ba sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// chos rnams kyi mchog zhi ba 'dod chags dang bral ba'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa byang chub (332)sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun chen po rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes skyabs 'gro ci nus su bya// gnyis pa 'gro kun pha mar rjes su dran pa ni/ mtha' med pa'i sems can thams cad pha ma drin can sha stag tu shes shing de'i drin gzor mkha' khyab kyi ma rnams bde ba dang ldan// sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i phyir du bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du lam zab mo 'di nyams su blang ngo*// snyam pas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam gyi sems can ma lus pa thams cad kyis skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan dag tu sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang*/

tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang*/ sgom pa'i rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba ci bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis dang por bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du bdag sogs sems can rnams kyis kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen po la sems bskyed par bgyi'o// sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o// ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o// dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o// yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar bgyi'o// zhes sems bskyed bya/ mthar skyabs yul thams cad rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la thim/ brgyud pa'i (333)bla ma rnams kyang rim gyis 'od du zhu nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ rtsa ba'i bla ma yang dgyes pa chen po'i ngang nas 'od du zhu rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlab par bsam la cung zad re mnyam par bzhag go /bar 'dir spro zhing nus na rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas dang*/ bla ma spyan ras gzigs la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsal btab la/ ku sā li'i tshogs gsog /maṇḍal/ dbang blang ba rnams mdzad pa'i phyag bzhes kyang yod mod dkyus la 'di tsam gyis chog /dngos su bsham pa'i mchod pa yod na byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis thugs rje chen po g.yas nor bu'i phreng ba dang g.yon shel gyi la bar brtse mor sangs rgyas stong gis mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros/

snod bcud kyi ma dag pa sbyangs/ oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par sprul pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung zad mi shes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ badzra ārghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shabda'i bar sbyar bas brlab/ gsum pa gnas lugs stong par rjes su dran pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba ཿswa bhā wa shuddho ྅haṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid dang rang gi sems ro gcig tu gyur pa thugs rje chen po'i thugs zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor mos nas de'i ngang du gnyis snang gi spros pa gzhan gyis bar mchod par 'dzin stangs gsal zhing dam par mnyam par 'jog cing*// de lta bu'i gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi bdag (334)nyid nga'o snyam du nga rgyal shugs drag tu bskyed pa ni chos sku'i lag rjes 'jog par byed pa stong pa'i rnal 'byor ro// bzhi pa rang lus lha skur rjes su dran pa la gnyis/ rim pa dang po bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ rim pa gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa la slob tshul lo// dang po la'ang thig le bco lnga las/ dang po phyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i thig le bsgom pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems kyi cha shas las grub pa'i 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur khyim gyi dbus su thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi 'dod snam pha gu dra ba drwa phyed mda' yab su shu rta babs sogs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang gi steng dang shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ 'od sngon por gyur pa kha dog so so'i rang mdog ltar 'chang ba la rnam pa yi ge'i gzugs can gyis bar mtshams med par khyab pa/

kha dog dang dbyibs rnams ma 'dres par so sor bkra ba'i steng gi yi ge thams cad oṃ/ shar ma/ lho ṇi/ nub pad/ byang me/ 'og hūm̐ du snang ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du sems nyid thig le dkar po gsal stong 'od kyi rang bzhin can de je cher song ba las rang nyid thub pa dang dbyer med pa'i thugs rje chen por gyur pa 'od du zhu ba las/ skad cig gis paṃ yig dkar po las nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i padma dkar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar a dkar po las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las thig le dkar po nam mkha' ltar mtha' dang bral ba'i rang bzhin can de yongs su gyur pa las bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho nam mkhas gar khyab tu skus khyab pa/ dbu bcu gcig phyag stong spyan stong dang ldan pa/ rtsa zhal dkar/ g.yas dmar/ g.yon ljang*/ de'i steng gi zhal dbus ljang*/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon (335)dmar/ de'i steng gi zhal dbus dmar/ g.yas ljang*/ g.yon dkar ba/ de'i steng na khro zhal nag po mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum pa/ ral pa dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa// de'i spyi bor zhi zhal dmar po gtsug tor can/ rtsa ba'i phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas gnyis pa na bgrang phreng*/ gsum pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas yi dwags kyi skom pa sel ba/ bzhi pa na 'khor lo// g.yon gyi gnyis pa na padma/ gsum pa na ril ba spyi blugs// bzhi pa na mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ phyag lhag ma dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gnyis po thams cad mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ ba spu'i bu ga re re na sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa/ de rnams na sangs rgyas byang sems mtha' klas pa bzhugs pa/ gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru las 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phros pas sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad pa zhig tu gyur par bsam la nga rgyal dang gsal snang ci thon bya'o// de ltar phyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bskyed rim gsal thebs nas rim pa bzhin dmigs pa phyi ma rnams la 'jug par bya ste/

de'i thugs kar thig le gnyis pa mi mjed kyi bkod pa sngar lta bu'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na oṃ ser po las thub pa chen po rnam par snang mdzad gangs chen mtsho sprul sku'i cha byad can/ g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ g.yas g.yon du mchog zung bzhengs te bzhugs pa/ theg pa gsum gyi 'khor tshogs rgya mtshos bskor ba/ de'i thugs kar thig le gsum pa kha ba can gyi thig le// gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rgya mtsho bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa ji lta ba bzhin bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar thig le bzhi pa yang sgos dbu ru (336)byang phyogs kyi thig le/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na hrīḥlas 'brom shel gyi khye'u dkar po zhi zhing 'dzum pa/ dbu skra mthing ga dpung pa'i thad du sleb pa/ phyag g.yas shel dkar gyi phreng ba dang*/ g.yon shel gyi 'khar ba rtse mor padma dkar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar zla ba'i gdan la yum chen mo// g.yas su bla ma mar me mdzad// g.yon du rgyal ba thub pa/ 'dab ma stong la sangs rgyas stong bzhugs pas mtshan pa 'dzin pa zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ 'di bzhi la rten gyi thig le zhes brjod de/ gtso bor snod kyi 'jig rten spyi dang bye brag ma dag pa'i snang zhen sbyangs nas dag pa rab 'byams su bsgyur bar byed pa'i phyir ro// de'i thugs kar lnga pa yum sher phyin ma'i thig le/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na a ser po las yum sher phyin ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas dang po thugs kar skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon dang po mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ g.yas 'og mas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon 'og mas glegs bam 'dzin pa/ zhabs skyil krung gi bzhugs pa/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyis bskor ba/ de'i thugs kar drug pa thub pa'i thig le/

gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na mūṃ ser po las thub pa bdud 'dul sprul sku'i cha lugs can/ g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ de'i thugs kar bdun pa spyan ras gzigs kyi thig le/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na hrīḥdakar po la spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ lhag ma gnyis shel phreng dang pad kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'khor byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs (337)kyis bskor ba/ de'i thugs kar brgyad pa rje btsun sgrol ma'i thig le/ gzhal yas khang gi nang pad zla'i steng na tāṃ ljang gu las sgrol ma ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang g.yon utpal/ mtheb srin gyis thugs kar 'dzin pa/ 'khor zhi ba'i lha mo dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ de'i thugs kar dgu pa sgrol ma drag mo'i thig le/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad nyi'i steng na tāṃ ljang nag las sgrol ma drag mo ljang nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ dang po gnyis gri thod/ 'og ma gnyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dang stag lpags kyi shams thabs dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol zhing g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ 'khor du lha mo drag mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ de'i thugs kar bcu pa mi g.yo ba'i thig le/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad nyi'i steng na hūm̐ mthing nag las mi g.yo ba sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ khro zhing gtum pa/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan cing glang lpags dang stag sham gsol ba/ g.yas brkyang gis tshogs kyi bdag po'i gdan la me dpung gi dbus na khro bo'i tshogs kyis bskor te bzhugs pa/ 'di drug la brten pa yi dam lha'i thig le zhes brjod do// gtso bor rang rang gi lus tha mal gyi snang zhen sbyangs nas yi dam gyi lha'i skur bsgom pa ste zab gsal gnyis med kyi lha'i rnal 'byor rtsal du bton pa dang*/

sngon 'brom chos kyi rgyal pos jo bo'i spyan sngar sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad lha bzhir bsdus nas gdams pa ltar// bka' gdams lha chos bdun ldan gyi rnam thar bskyang bar 'dod pa rnams kyis gtso bor nyams su blang dgos pa'i phyir ro// (338)de'i thugs kar bcu gcig pa jo bo'i thig le/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na hūm̐ dkar po las mgon po a ti sha longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs can/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ skyil krung gi bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun du thub pa longs spyod cha lugs can/ g.yas su spyan ras gzigs/ g.yon du sgrol ma/ rgyab tu mi g.yo ba/ shar lhor jo bo paṇḍi ta'i cha byad can/ lho nub tu 'brom dge bsnyen gyi cha byad can/ nub tu rngog dang byang shar du khu ston gnyis bod ston rab byung gi cha byad can/ steng gi cha la brgyud pa gsum gyi bla ma'i tshogs rnams bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar bcu gnyis pa 'brom gyi thig le gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na hrīḥdamar po las 'brom chos kyi rgyal po longs sku'i gar chas su gzhugs pa/ dgung lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ g.yas pad dkar dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i mdun du phyi ltar na rang dang cha lugs mtshungs pa'i khye'u dkar po bzhi// g.yas su ser po bzhi/ g.yon du ljang gu bzhi/ rgyab tu dmar po bzhi/ nang ltar na sku mched gsum sogs/ gsang ba ltar na rigs lnga'i ngo bo// steng gi cha la brgyud pa gsum gyi bla ma rnams dang*/ gsang ba ye shes sogs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs du ma rnams u rgyan gyi yul du mdzad pa ji lta ba bzhin gar stabs sna tshogs su bsgyur ba/ de'i thugs kar bcu gsum pa byams pa'i thig le/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na maiṃ ser po las rgyal ba byams pa dge slong rnam sbyar chos gos gyon pa/ mtshan dpe dang ldan pa/

chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yas g.yon na nam mkha' dri ma med pa dang btsun pa spyan ras gzigs gnyis dge slong gi cha byad can bzhengs te bzhugs pa/ steng gi cha la 'phags pa thogs (339)med sogs rgya chen spyod brgyud kyi bla ma'i tshogs rnams bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar bcu bzhi pa 'jam dbyangs kyi thig le/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na dhīḥdamar ser las rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs rab byung sprul sku'i cha lugs can/ phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas g.yon du jo bo dang spyan ras gzigs rab byung gi rnam pa can/ steng gi cha la mgon po klu sgrub sogs zab mo lta brgyud kyi bla ma'i tshogs rnams bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar bco lnga pa rdo rje 'chang gi thig le/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du padma nyi ma zla ba'i gdan la hūm̐ mthing ga las rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs can sku mdog sngon po// rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol te 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas g.yon du mchog zung longs sku'i cha lugs can gyis bzhengs pa/ steng gi cha la tai lo nā ro sogs nyams len byin rlabs brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs rnams bzhugs pa/ 'di rnams la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i thig le zhes brjod do// gsang sngags bla med kyi lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa myur ba myur bar rgyud la skyed pa'i phyir bla ma'i rnal 'byor la rtsal du bton pa yin pa'i phyir ro// de yan chad ni gzugs sku'i lag rjes 'jog byed rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'o// gnyis pa rdzogs rim ni/ rdo rje 'chang de'i thugs kar bcu drug pa byang chub sems kyi thig le/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad zla'i steng na hūm̐ (hūm̐ ser po las gser mdog tu bsgom pa'ang yod)sngon po las sangs rgyas chos kyi sku mthing skya mnyam bzhag dang skyil krung can chos kyi dbyings las mi g.yo bzhin du sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rnam (340)rol sna tshogs su ston pa/

de'i snying dkyil du shin tu phra ba'i rlung gi ngo bo byang chub sems kyi thig le dkar dwangs yungs 'bru tsam pa/ de rgya je cher song nas nor bu rin po che'i snod rgya che zhing dpangs mtho la 'od 'tsher ba/ de'i nang du rang sems thig le ser po sran ma tsam pa dwangs shing 'od 'tsher ba mer mer g.yo zhing 'ju ba lta bu// de rgya je cher song bas thig le'i rgya mtsho gser gtso ma'i mdog ltar dwangs shing khod snyoms pa/ gzhi brtan pa/ rgya che ba/ khyab che ba// gzugs brnyan thams cad 'char ba zhig tu gyur par bsam la sems zhugs pa bzhin gtad nas rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pas rlung sems 'jug pa gcig pas/ sems snying dbus kyi dhū tir zin pa na/ rlung yang de nyid du zin te/ rlung dbu mar zhugs pa'i rtags su sna bug nas mnyam rgyu kho nar 'babs/ gnas pa'i rtags su rnal 'byor la mnyam par bzhag pa'i skabs su lto ba mi 'gul/ thim pa'i rtags su 'od gsal du ba la sogs pa'i snang ba shar ba ste de lta bu'i zhugs gnas thim gsum gyi stsal rdzogs te yul bde ba chen po dang*/ yul can stong pa nyid zung 'jug tu grub pas na rdzogs rim du 'gro ba yin no// de ltar thig le bcu drug po de re re la'ang*/ rgyas par na rjes dran lnga tshang bar bsgoms te rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ chos sku'i lag rjes 'jog byed stong pa'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa dang*/ de'i ngang las lha bsgoms pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa la gsal snang thon nas/ rang gi sems kyi cha shas shig gis 'gro kun pha mar rjes su dran pa sems can thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi nang du khrid de dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la thun mong ma yin pa'i yan lag bdun pa phul ba dang*/ (341)phyag dang bskor ba mang du byas nas gzungs sngags bzlas pas slar yang nang ma nang mar 'jug pa dang*/ ngag sngags su rjes dran gyis so so'i snying po dmigs pa'i gnad dang bcas pas bzla ba rnams bya zhing*// mdor bsdu na/

skabs 'dir gnas gsum byin rlabs man lhan cig tu bya ba ni/ lha tshogs thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po// mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dag pa rab 'byams kyi zhing khams nas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ zhes dbang bskur/ lus gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma spyi gtsug tu 'khyil ba las rang rang gi sa bon gyis dbur brgyan par mos pa ste yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyi tshul du gsal btab nas/ rang gi sems kyi cha shas las grub pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros te/ phyag dang phyag yul gnyis stong pa'i// rnam dag sku la ye phyag 'tshal// skye gnas 'jig pas ma gos pa'i// dri med mchod tshogs 'bul lo lha// sgo gsum skye gnas 'jig bral ba'i// nyes pa'i g.yang sa mthol lo bshags// stong yang sna tshogs skur ston pa'i// grangs med 'dren la rjes yi rang*// smon dang mtshan mas stong pa yi// 'khor lo dbyings su bskor du gsol// skye bas stong pa'i chos sku khyed// lhun grub gnas pa'i rang bzhin las// gang (342)du'ang 'da' bar ma mdzad cig /dge ba 'di yis 'khor ba rnams// 'di 'drar rtogs te 'di 'dra ba'i// gzhal yas khang du 'drongs 'gyur te// gsang sngags 'di bzhin spyod par bsngo// gnas skabs kri ya'i lha lnga bzhin// pad dkar stong ldan lte ba la// zla ba zhun ma'i gdan steng du// phyi nang gsang ba de nyid kyi// bskyed rdzogs mchog tu bsngags par shog

/glo bur 'di yang chos dbyings las// tha dad ci yang yod ma mchis// tha dad med par phun tshogs pa'i// bkra shis phun sum tshogs par shog /gtsang ma rigs kyi bkra shis shog /thog mtha' bar gsum gtsang ma las// g.yos pa med pa'i bkra shis shog /zhes yan lag bdun pa dang*// rgyas par tshigs bcad sbrags pa'am// bsdu na/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā ārghaṃ pra tī tstsha swā hā nas/ shabda'i bar sbyar ba'i chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ spro na 'dod yon lnga dang*/ rgyal srid bdun/ bkra shis rdzas rtags sogs kyang spyi ltar phul/ ma dag zhing gi 'jig rten ji snyed pa// dag pa rab 'byams lha yi gzhal yas su// mngon par legs sgyur bcom ldan thub pa che// rje btsun phyag na padmo'i tshogs la bstod// sde snod gsum gyi yum chen sher phyin ma// sangs rgyas zhi dang khro bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// kun 'dus bka' gdams lhag pa'i lha mchog bzhi// skyabs mchog yi dam chos skyong rnams la bstod// rgya chen spyod dang zab mo lta ba'i lam// nyams len snyan brgyud gdams pa mchog gi gter// rgyun chad med par 'dzin cing spel mkhas pa// lha chos bdun ldan brgyud pa rnams la bstod// gdod nas rnam dag snang stong dag pa'i gshis// bzhin lag mtshan dpe'i 'ja' tshon rnam bkra ba// (343)'gyur med chos sku gsal stong rlung sems zung*// ches phra thig le'i rnam par shar la bstod// lha chos bdun gyi nying khu thig le'i chos// nyams su bstar bas tshe 'dir zung 'jug sku// mngon du byas te don gnyis ma lus pa// 'bad med lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes rdo rje'i glu snyan 'gyur gyi nyams dang ldan pas yon tan rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas bstod par bsam/ de nas rang nyid thugs rje chen po phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par logs su bye bas/ 'gro kun pha mar rjes su dran pas snying rje chen pos bltas te/

rang nyid kyis sna drangs sems can thams cad phyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs// thugs rje chen po rgyal ba rgya mtsho la phyag dang bskor ba byas te gsol ba btab/ khyad par du rang gi lus longs spyod dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge tshogs rgya mtsho dang bcas pa thams cad 'gro ba mgon dang skyabs med pa rnams kyi phan pa dang bde ba gang la gang 'tshams kyi nyer 'tsho'i rten du 'gyur ba'i phyir phongs pa med par lha tshogs rnams la kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin chen por phul bas zag med kyi bde bas dgyes/ gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum dang khyad par thugs ka'i sa bon dang sngags phreng las 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun dang bcas pa byung*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi lus sems la zhugs/ las nyon sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thob par bsam mo// lnga pa ngag sngags su rjes su dran pa la gnyis te/ rim pa dang po'i lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa'i sgo nas thig le bcu drug gi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul ba'i bzlas brjod ji ltar bya ba dang*/ rim pa gnyis pa'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas (344)rlung sngags dbyer med du byas te rdo rje'i bzlas pa la slob tshul lo// dang po ni/ thig le bcu drug gi lha tshogs rnams kyi gtso bo'i thugs kar so so'i sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng ba bkod la/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ gsang gsum gyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas rang la thim/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad kyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sbyang*/ thams cad dag pa'i zhing gi rnam rol du gyur pa bsams la/ thig le dang po la/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ zhes bzla/

de bzhin du gnyis pa la/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā// gsum bzhi gnyis la yig drug dang*/ lnga pa la/ tadya thā/ oṃ ga te ga te pā ra ga te pā ra saṃ ga te bo dhi swā hā/ drug pa la mu ni/ bdun pa la yig drug /brgyad pa la/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ dgu par/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re hūm̐ phaṭa/ bcu pa la/ oṃ tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ bcu gcig pa la/ bka' gdams lha bzhi'i sngags sam/ yang na/ oṃ ma hā gu ru dī paṃ ka ra a ti sha swā hā/ bcu gnyis pa la yig drug /bcu gsum pa la/ oṃ mai tri mai tri ma hā mai tri ye swā hā dang*/ oṃ mai tri ye swā hā gang rung*/ bcu bzhi pa la/ oṃ wā gi shwa ri mūṃ/ bco lnga pa la/ oṃ badzra dhṛ kra hūm̐ hūm̐/ bcu drug pa la/ oṃ dharma kā ya siddhi hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes so sor brgya stong sogs ci nus su bzla/ yang na/ de thams cad la yig drug kho na bzla zhing*/ gtso bor yig drug la rtsal du 'don/ de'i tshe dmigs pa ni/ rang phyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i thugs rje chen po'i sku'i ba spu'i khung bu re re yang zhing khams (345)bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ de re re yang rgyal ba sras bcas bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyi zer la rdul 'khrigs pa ltar bzhugs pa thams cad kyi zhal nas kyang yi ge drug pa'i sgra 'ur dir re gsungs pa dang*/ der ma zad zhing khams de dang der gnas pa'i sa chu me rlung ste rten 'byung ba bzhi'i sgra dang*/ brten pa sems can thams cad kyang thugs rje chen po'i rnam rol tu shar bas yi ge drug pa'i sgra 'ur 'ur sgrogs par bsam la/ ci snang lha sku/ sgrar grags yi ge drug pa/ dran rtog thugs rje chen po'i thugs stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can du blta ba'i lam khyer zab mo dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas bzlas pa bya ba ni bsod nams kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin te/

de'i rgyu mtshan zhib par za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo sde sogs las shes par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ lus gnad bsrangs te rlung ro bsal la cung zad ngal bso// de nas sna bug gnyis nas rlung nang du 'jug pa oṃ gyi gdangs dang*/ snying ga'i byang chub sems kyi thig le la gnas pa āḥ'i gdangs dang*/ de las phyir ldang ba hūm̐ gi gdangs dang ngo bo dbyer med du sbyor ba'i rdo rje'i bzlas pa la 'bad do// spyir 'di'i rdzogs rim nyid 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs kyi rdzogs rim thig le bzhi rim dang mthun zhing*/ khyad par mthar thug lhan skyes kyi dga' ba'i dbang du byas te snying gar mi shigs pa'i thig le bsgom tshul dang*/ 'di'i byang chub sems kyi thig le gnyis don gcig tu 'bab pa'i phyir/ tshul 'di la ye shes zhabs lugs kyi gzhung chen po rnams dang*/ man ngag gi yi ge rnams legs par rtogs par byas te phan tshun lto sbyar nas nges shes bskyed par bya'o zhes bla ma phyi ma rnams gsung ngo// gsum pa rjes ni/ thun de las ldang (346)bar brtsam pa na/ yi ge brgya pa ci nus su bzla bas ting nge 'dzin gyi lhag chad kha bskang ba dang*/ brtan cing nus pa gong 'phel du byas nas/ sngar ltar mchod cing bstod/ rang nyid gtso bo'i thugs ka'i thig le ser po yungs 'bru tsam dwangs shing gsal ba de las 'od zer 'phros pa snod bcud thams cad lan tshwa chur bcug pa bzhin 'od dkar po bde ba chen po'i ngo bor mer gyis zhu nas phyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lha'i gzhal yas khang la thim zhing*/ thig le bco lnga pa'i bar gyi gzhal yas khang de rnams kyang rang rang gi kha dog gi thig ler gyur nas phyi ma phyi ma/ nang ma nang ma la thim pa'i mthar/ thig le ser po sran ma tsam pa zhig tu gyur/ de nyid sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'i spyi bo'i oṃ la thim/ de āḥl/ de hūm̐ la/ de yang shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems kyi thig le la thim nas stong nyid snying rje gnyis su med par gyur bar bsams la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag

/de'i ngang las skad cig gis rang nyid thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sku 'ja' tshon ltar lam gyis shar ba'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par mos la/ brgyud pa gsum ldan bla ma thams cad dang*// yi dam thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs dang*// jo bo yab sras thugs rje can rnams kyis// bdag gi smon pa'i gnas 'di 'grub par mdzod// 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge tshogs bsdoms pa'i mthus// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa// brgyud pa gsum ldan bla ma dam pa yis// tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rjes bzung ste// bka' gdams rnam thar gtsang ma mthar phyin shog /skyes bu gsum gyi lam du gsung rab kun// bsdus te nyams su blangs pas rgyud sbyangs nas// (347)gsang chen sgor zhugs dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung*// zung 'jug snying gi thig le 'grub par shog /lha bzhis lus dang sde snod gsum gyis ngag /bslab pa gsum gyis sems brgyan rjes dran lnga'i// nyams len mthar phyin 'gro kun sgrol ba la// rgyal ba rgya mtsho nyid dang mtshungs par shog /gsang chen snying gi thig le'i gdams pa mchog /dben pa'i gnas su nyams su lan pas// jo bo'i bka' srung dgu bcu rtsa gnyis kyis// g.yel ba med par rtag tu grogs byed shog /zhes bsngo smon dang*/ legs tshogs kun gyi 'byung gnas bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /sku gsum mngon du gyur pa sangs rgyas rnams kyi bkra shis shog /thog mtha' bar du dge ba dam pa'i chos kyi bkra shis shog /bslab gsum rnam par dag pa dge 'dun rnams kyi bkra shis shog /bdag gzhan mnyam brje rin chen byang chub sems kyi= thabs shes zung 'jug rim gnyis rnal 'byor zab mo'i bkra shis shog /phan bde'i gzhir gyur thub bstan phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /'gro kun theg mchog chos kyi dpal la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /ces shis pa brjod cing spyod lam la 'jug par bya'o// de ltar na de rnams kyi sgo nas bka' gdams glegs bam rin po che'i don gyi snying po mdor bsdus te rjes dran lnga'i tshul gyis nyams su len tshul gyi khrid 'jam dbyangs kun dga' grol mchog gi khrid brgya sogs las kyang mdo tsam 'byung ba dang*/

da ltar gyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes dang zhal lung las ji ltar thos pa bzhin ngag 'don dang dmigs rim phyogs gcig tu bkod pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ de las kyang rgyas par spro na// (348)thig le dang po'i skabs lha'i gsal snang dang*/ tshogs bsags pa'i dmigs pa nan tan du byas nas/ thig le gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ bzhi pa rnams la rim pa bzhin skyes bu chung ngu'i khrid/ 'bring gi khrid/ chen po theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong ba'i khrid rnams bsgom/ lnga pa la sher phyin gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyi 'phro 'dus bdud sde'i dpung tshogs rnams bcom nas zhi bar bsam mo// drug pa bdun pa brgyad pa dgu pa bcu pa rnams la bka' gdams lha bzhi'i khrid bsgom zhing*/ khyad par sgrol ma drag mo dang mi g.yo ba gnyis la dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i dmigs pa dang drag sngags bzla// thig le bcu gcig pa 'dir ni brgyud pa gsum la brten pa'i bla ma'i sgrub pa gtso bor bya/ bcu gnyis pa glegs bam rin po che'i skyes rab spyi dang*/ khyad par dkon mchog 'bangs kyi o rgyan gyi yul du byon pa'i rdo rje'i glu dang chos zab mo dpag tu med pa'i skor gyi rnam thar yid yul du nges par byas nas rang nyid kyang blos der phyin pa dang de 'dra ba byas pa'i bsam sgom nan tan du bya/ bcu gsum pa la zhi gnas gtso bor bsgom/ bcu bzhi pa la zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba bsgom/ bco lnga par rang gang mos pa'i bla med kyi rgyud sde zhig ga rdzogs rim dang sbyar na legs/ bcu drug pa ni sangs rgyas chos sku'i thig le de nyid grangs med par spro zhing sdud pa sogs kyi ngang nas thig le'i nang du sangs rgyas kyi zhing rten dang brten par bcas pa grangs med par 'char ba dang*/ de rnams la rang nyid kyis mjal zhing chos nyan pa sogs mang du bsam pa'i mthar thig le de nyid gsal stong dbyings rig spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag

/thun bsdu ba ni bcu drug po thams cad la rigs 'gre'o// 'khrid rgyun khyed nyams su len na bcu drug po gzhan rnams rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar chag med tsam byas/ rang gang mos pa zhig dang*/ (349)bcu drug pa gnyis la nan tan du bya/ shin tu bsdus pa byed na/ thig le thams cad kyi bskyed chog tsam byas nas nyams len dmigs phug pa gcig la byas kyang rung ngo*// mdor na lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas zung 'jug gi bar gyi lam thams cad stan thog gcig tu nyams su len tshul tshang la ma nor ba 'di ni gdul bya rin po che lta bu'i gang zag snyigs dus kyi tshe thung gcig la 'tshang rgya ba'i lam tshang lam nor ba yin no// smras pa/ mkhas grub gaṅgā'i yab gcig ti se'i gzugs// mnyam med dī paṃ kā ra yab sras kyi// zab chos thig le bcu drug snying po'i gtam// bdud rtsi'i mchod yon gtan pa med pa sbrengs// de las byung ba'i dge ba ni// dpag bsam gsar ba'i rjes 'gro bas// 'gro ba kun la grub gnyis kyi// dga' ston mchog tu sbyin gyur cig /zhes pa'ang rje bla ma bcu phrag rig pa'i paṇḍi ta dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas dpal bzang pos chos grwa chen po bkra shis lhun po dpal gyi sde chen phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i phun tshogs khang gsar du ji ltar stsal ba bzhin gzhon nu mkhyen brtse'i ming gis zin bris su btab pa sarba dā ka lyā ṇaṃ bha ba tu/// /(350)
